goal: Implement and prove one bounded Agent Studio phase and its selected feature-oracle behavior without crossing dependency or approval gates.
done_when: The selected phase report has Status: passed or a user-approved waiver.
Every required command, browser, runtime, eval, security, migration, and regression gate has durable evidence.
The selected Oracle item is passing or explicitly waived and cites actor plus independent critic artifacts.
Source facts, continuity boundaries, progress, handoff, loop-state, and rollback notes are current.
stop_when: A direct dependency is not passed and has no explicit user waiver.
Credentials, external systems, migration, Docker, deployment, destructive action, or product choice requires missing approval.
The required fix expands outside likely_edit_paths or changes a global invariant without an approved contract update.
The same blocker repeats without new evidence or max_iterations is reached.
